versions.name: Clements Scout Ranch / Trevor Rees-Jones Scout Camp

features.note: Five lakes across 3,200 acres, including the 160-acre Lake Murchison.
Stocked lakes with several fishing docks, holding largemouth bass.
A resident herd of horses, with an equestrian program and monthly trail rides for units.
The Roy and Frances Rea COPE Center, a challenge course for youth aged thirteen and older.
Part of the COPE challenge course.
The John Coffman Climbing and Rappelling Complex, a 60-foot wooden tower.
A museum of natural history at Trevor Rees-Jones Scout Camp.
Two large pavilions at each of the two camps, one at the water's edge.
Philmont-style backcountry camps on the ranch.

versions.summary: Circle Ten Council's Scouts BSA resident summer camp at Clements Scout Ranch, encompassing Trevor Rees-Jones Scout Camp and Camp Meisenbach, located near Athens, Texas.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/571-2026TRJSummerCamp); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
